summary: v0.4.0 Phase 5A (Certification Prep Expansion: DEA track + AIF/MLA/DEA content) verified end to end. Added 20 new backend tests in test_v040_phase5a.py (all pass) and updated 3 stale assertions in prior suites for the new content counts. Full backend regression: 88/88 pass across 9 files. Frontend Playwright pass on desktop 1920 and mobile 390 confirmed Learn Hub with 5 tracks (CLF_SAA/AIF/MLA/DEA/MIXED), track-detail, cert-disclaimer, and cert-practice-note; Flashcards per-track counts DEA=15, AIF=14, MLA=19, CLF_SAA=34, MIXED=73 (exact match, spec on the dot); flashcard flip + read-aloud on DEA cards; Test Mode DEA loads 13 questions and server-grades end to end with share-test-card on results; Match Mode DEA loads 'Batch Data Lake Pipeline' with 3 slots and 6 tray items; no full-page horizontal overflow on /learn, /learn/cards, /learn/test, /learn/match, /; 0 console errors. Answer keys ('correct') are absent from Test session and Match session payloads (verified by backend tests). Every DEA/AIF/MLA match exercise grades 100 when all slots are placed correctly and every slot's correct id resolves to a real SERVICE_CARDS service.

critical_code_review_comments: learn_content.py enrich_cards() cleanly appends _EXTRA_CARDS (AIF/MLA/DEA concept cards) after the game's SERVICE_CARDS so Play data is untouched. 12 AIF + 12 MLA + 15 DEA concept cards + 2 pre-existing MLA-tagged service cards (redshift, kinesis) etc. yield the exact 14/19/15/34/73 per-track counts the spec called for. Clean.

test_bank.py Phase 5A additions: AIF now 15 questions (aif_01..aif_15), MLA 15 (mla_01..mla_15), DEA 13 (dea_01..dea_13). SESSION_SIZE=15 -> AIF/MLA return 15 and beta=False (pool>=n), DEA returns 13 and beta=True (pool<n). Behavior matches spec's 'small beta note is acceptable' for DEA.

match_bank.py Phase 5A additions: 4 AIF + 5 MLA + 5 DEA exercises added. Every slot's 'correct' service id resolves to SERVICE_CARDS. Every exercise grades 100 with perfect placement (verified via API loop). Sanitizer strips 'correct' from every slot in session responses.

LearnHub.jsx: TRACKS array has DEA and MIXED with track-status badges (Expanding/Mixed) driving STATUS_STYLES color palette. cert-disclaimer and cert-practice-note both render US English with no em dashes. localStorage 'cf_learn_track' round-trips correctly.
LearnCards.jsx isBetaTrack now includes DEA in addition to AIF/MLA; MIXED/CLF_SAA hide the beta note. Correct behavior for the interim.
LearnTest.jsx and LearnMatch.jsx TRACK_LABEL both include DEA; getLearnTrack() from LearnHub reads localStorage so switching track on the Hub carries into Test/Match reliably.
No em dashes introduced in the new content (Phase 5A cards/questions/exercises use plain ASCII hyphens and periods). US English throughout.
No AWS or NCCU affiliation implied; cert-disclaimer states 'unofficial, student-built learning tool' and 'not official AWS exam material'.
